messages:
alex: kicking off a thread — acme-edge wants a dedicated POC in apac-southeast1 with 4x A100s. Provisioning fails with "InsufficientQuota". Anyone seen this?

kia: do we have their reservation config? strict_affinity or flexible? also need zone list.

alex: they requested strict_affinity, prefer single AZ for NUMA reasons. they also asked about spot vs reserved pricing and whether private deployment needed for security questionnaire.

marco: from infra — provisioner error: 
```
{ "error": "InsufficientQuota", "details": "Requested GPUs:4 available:2" }
```
we only have 2 A100s in apac-southeast1 pool right now.

jen: support here. I can verify pool sizes: run `rwctl get-pools --region apac-southeast1 --type a100` -> output: 
```
pool-1  available_gpus: 2  reserved: false
pool-dedicated-poc  available_gpus: 0  reserved: true
```
so two A100s free.

kia: options: 1) reduce to 2x A100s for POC, 2) create multi-zone spec (affinity=flexible), 3) create pool in apac-east1 and route. Which does sales want for timeline?

alex: customer insists on 4x single-AZ for perf testing. fast timeline (this week). They're asking if we can backfill capacity or if Private (on-prem) is the only option.

marco: backfill from cloud provider will take 48-72h for quota increase + provisioning. not guaranteed. Private on-prem would be weeks. Short-term: create a temporary cross-region pool in apac-east1 with 4x A100s and set smart routing with affinity_policy=prefer_region to keep latency ok. I'll need approval for cross-region POC.

sre-bot: provision-request 1805001240 accepted -> pool-create job queued (job_id: j-9a3f)

jen: note on pricing: Dedicated pricing uses per-GPU monthly rate. For POC shorter than 1 month we use pro-rated daily rate. For A100 we typically quote $X/day per GPU for ad-hoc POC (send to billing for exact figure). Also discounted if they sign reserved commit.

kia: regarding security questionnaire: for POC we can provide VPC peering + customer-managed KMS keys. If they still require air-gapped, escalate to private_deploy. Send me the questionnaire items and I can fill the POC-safe responses.

alex: action items: marco -> open cross-region pool in apac-east1 and start provisioning (48h estimate). kia -> draft POC quote with pro-rated pricing and reserved vs on-demand options. jen -> confirm VPC peering steps and KMS support for POC. I'll loop in customer and propose reduced-workaround (2x A100 immediate) vs 4x cross-region.

marco: started capacity request with cloud provider (ticket CP-9872). ETA 60-72h. I also kicked off j-9a3f to try best-effort in apac-east1.

alex: thanks team. I'll send customer an update with both options. :thumbsup:
